query:
UPDATE media_item
        SET missing_since = now(),
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE deleted = false
          AND missing_since IS NULL
          AND (
              relative_path = ANY($1)
              OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM unnest($2::text[]) AS p(prefix)
                  WHERE left(media_item.relative_path, length(p.prefix) + 1) = p.prefix || '/'
              )
          )
